review_candidates.title: Network Engineer (Remote Opportunity)
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The Network Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining secure and resilient network solutions that ensure high availability, performance, and scalability. Location: Remote (with occasional travel as required) Responsibilities Design, configure, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, and load balancers. Create and maintain detailed network diagrams, runbooks, and standard operating procedures. Provide Tier III escalat
eligibility_evidence: Support WAN, LAN, and wireless networking solutions across hybrid on-premise and cloud environments.
Support network upgrades, migrations, and modernization initiatives, including cloud-based networking in Azure and hybrid environments.
Familiarity with cloud networking (Azure, AWS, or similar), hybrid connectivity, and software-defined networking.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field from an accredited college or university recognized by the U.S. 5+ years of experience. Hands-on experience as a Network Engineer supporting enterprise-scale environments. Expertise in configuring and managing Cisco and Juniper routers/switches. Proficiency in load balancing technologies, including F5 LTM/GTM/DNS, with the ability to troubleshoot persistence, SSL offload, and traffic steering. Additional Qualifications Relevant certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, JNCIE, PCNSE, or F5-CTS. Understanding of the network and security requirements for hosting and accessing AI services, such as secure connectivity to cloud AI endpoints, data egress controls, and segmentation.

review_candidates.title: System Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Responsibilities Keep production reliable and fast: handle alerts and incidents, remove bottlenecks, plan capacity, maintain backups, and disaster recovery. Run and upgrade Kubernetes clusters; maintain CI/CD pipelines and development environments. Requirements 4+ years running Linux servers in production, with strong troubleshooting skills.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is a hands-on role: you will design and automate infrastructure, improve reliability and performance, and understand systems down to the kernel, network and database level. Requirements 4+ years running Linux servers in production, with strong troubleshooting skills. Hands-on Kubernetes in production.
